affected_component: ui/services/autopilot.py fresh-audit projection (FRESH_AUDIT_PASS_REASONS, singular reason_code) + tests/ui/test_autopilot.py fixture shape
invariant: The autopilot judges the fresh-input audit by the audit CLI's real payload: ok=true with the singular reason_code in {FRESH_INPUT_PASS, FRESH_INPUT_SEMANTIC_PASS} (the two ACTIVE decisions of tool_release._record_audit_decision) is a pass and the journey continues to ACTIVE; any other outcome is recorded with the audit's own reason_code (e.g. SEMANTIC_VERIFIER_MISMATCH) rather than a generic FRESH_AUDIT_FAILED. The test fixture uses the real shape, so a payload shape the CLI never emits can no longer keep a dead check green.
